text:
Maya: quick heads-up — Slate pilot onboarding kicks off next Tue. Need a warm handoff + enablement + a lightweight feedback loop. Can we sync on who's owning the first 2 weeks?
Julian: I can run the first enablement session. available Tue 10-11 or Wed 2-3. prefer Tue so we can unblock integrations early. :white_check_mark:
Ravi: Tue 10 works for me. I'll bring the quick-runbook for their API keys and network allowlist.
Ava: I'll own the feedback collection. proposing a 3-question micro-survey after day 3 and a short check-in after day 10. link prototype: https://redwood.ai/survey/slate-pilot (still editable)
Maya: perfect. also flagging renewal risk small but present — their legal team asked about data residency. we've got Private as an option but need to document timeline. putting @Ava and @Ravi on risk notes.
Julian: noted. can we add a one-pager to the enablement deck about deployment modes + expected lead times? I can add a slide.
Ravi: yes — adding two bullets: (1) Private deployment: ~8-12 weeks + compliance checks, (2) Dedicated reserve: ~2-4 weeks.
Ava: survey draft (short):
```
1) How easy was onboarding? (1-5)
2) Any blocker you'd like us to prioritize? (free text)
3) Would you consider Redwood for production in 90 days? (yes/no/maybe)
```
Maya: love it. can we also capture an operational success metric — e.g., inference latency under 200ms for requests with <=512 tokens? put that on the check-in agenda.
Julian: adding to agenda. quick invite snippet for Tue 10:00-10:45 PST — "Slate Pilot: Enablement + Integrations". copy for calendar: 
```
When: Tue May 14, 10:00-10:45 PST
Attendees: Maya, Julian, Ravi, Slate engineers (TBD)
Agenda: quick intros, API key & allowlist walkthrough, runbook handoff, next steps, feedback plan
```
Ava: I can draft the day-3 micro-survey to auto-send from Intercom. Ravi, can you attach the runbook to the calendar invite?
Ravi: yep, will attach. also posting the runbook link here once final: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/slate-onboard-v1
triage-bot: reminder — onboarding checklist incomplete: docs attached, success metric missing.
Maya: thanks bot. Julian, can you confirm speaker for the runbook demo?
Julian: I'll demo the runbook. Maya, can you intro the customer during the session?
Maya: yes — I'll do the intro and call out escalation path.
Ava: once done, I'll compile feedback and send a one-page pulse to the account team on day 11. format: 1) adoption signals, 2) blockers, 3) renewal flag.
Maya: great. next steps: Julian send invite + slide update, Ravi attach runbook, Ava finalize survey, Maya do intro + own escalation. :thumbsup:
Julian: will do. 
Maya: thanks all — tagging this thread for the onboarding doc entry.
